# Vendored source provenance

`phonemize.js` is byte-identical at review on 2026-10-15 to
[`hexgrad/kokoro`, `kokoro.js/src/phonemize.js`, revision
`e0bf641def52db8471d4330d04948056e08e2248`](https://github.com/hexgrad/kokoro/blob/e0bf641def52db8471d4330d04948056e08e2248/kokoro.js/src/phonemize.js).
Credit belongs to its upstream authors. The upstream repository's Apache-2.0
license is retained in [KOKORO-LICENSE](KOKORO-LICENSE). This helper is excluded
from any proposed first-party MIT grant.

The helper imports `phonemizer`; its wrapper license does not by itself clear
that package's embedded eSpeak engine. The [third-party review](../docs/third-party-licenses.md)
records the unresolved binary/source provenance and redistribution requirements.
